quiz.title: 45-Second Diagnostic: Find Your Immediate Field Playbook
quiz.desc: Answer 3 workplace scenarios below to pinpoint your exact volume and emergency chapter.
quiz.step_1_q: What situation gives you the biggest headache this week?
quiz.step_1_o1: • "I have to micromanage staff details because tasks go off-track otherwise."
quiz.step_1_o2: • "My own deliverables stall because all day is eaten by meetings and team fires."
quiz.step_1_o3: • "I lead other managers, but they still toss strategic decisions back up to me."
quiz.step_2_q: Which desk conversation script do you urgently need right now?
quiz.step_2_o1: • "Delivering critical feedback when work deviates without breaking morale."
quiz.step_2_o2: • "Setting boundary shields and negotiating unplanned upper-management interrupts."
quiz.step_2_o3: • "Delegating strategic ownership to subordinate leads without micromanagement."
quiz.step_3_q: What crucial outcome do you want to achieve within the next 30 days?
quiz.step_3_o1: • "Team aligns on 3K targets early and operates autonomously on L1–L4 calibration."
quiz.step_3_o2: • "Implementing 30/70 bandwidth caps, trimming wasteful meetings, restoring energy."
quiz.step_3_o3: • "Aligning multi-team OKRs and grooming direct leads for succession."
quiz.result_desc: Based on your inputs, this playbook delivers immediate tactical tools for your team friction.

items.q: Is this a physical book or a digital web platform?
items.a: crow.asia is a high-speed (< 25ms) web-first interactive field playbook. Read seamlessly across mobile and desktop without installs, with 16:9 Remotion animations, cloud checklists, and download-ready A5 Master PDFs.

items.q: What is the difference between Casual and Standard registers?
items.a: All strategies and frameworks are 100% identical. In Indonesian, Casual uses informal peer phrasing (Gue/Lo) for startup cultures, while Standard uses formal professional phrasing (Saya/Kamu). Non-Indonesian editions use standard international English.

items.q: How long does access last after payment?
items.a: Access is lifetime for your account. All future manuscript updates and checklist sync are included with zero monthly subscriptions.
We accept Credit/Debit Cards, QRIS, Virtual Accounts, and international payments with instant automated activation.
